explication: Rufus is a Windows utility for formatting removable or virtual media and producing bootable installation drives. The principal workflow is user configuration, media and image selection, filesystem formatting, boot-media installation, optional Windows customization or persistence setup, validation, and delivery to the target drive. The tree shows dedicated ISO, WIM, archive, filesystem, boot-sector, and device layers. Some orchestration details are inferred from documented capabilities because the main implementation excerpts were not provided.
